assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original editorial cover for a Persian premium web studio article about service-business editorial strategy and a useful content calendar.
Scene: an immaculate dark midnight-teal editorial planning table. Main subject: a crafted brushed-metal scheduling rail with five generously spaced blank ivory topic cards, each held upright in a delicate mint glass clip. A small telephone receiver and an actual precision repair component sit at the start, suggesting real customer questions becoming specific useful articles. A modest open research folio and one pencil, no more.
Style: premium photorealistic 3D editorial still-life, tactile paper, brushed metal, smoked glass, finely grained dark stone. Elevated three-quarter wide view, clear central subject safe for central thumbnail crop, carefully balanced negative space. Wide landscape 16:9.
Palette: #001014 and #031b22, controlled #00dfd6 and #76e8db light, warm ivory. Soft large studio key light and precise cyan rim reflections, calm focused atmosphere.
Constraints: every card and paper completely blank; no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, charts, screen UI, robots, newspaper motifs, laptops, shields, generic floating cubes. This is an illustrative planning still life, not an actual client project.
assets.alt: میز برنامه‌ریزی محتوا با کارت‌های موضوعی روی ریل، دفتر خالی و ابزار کنار تلفن مشتری
assets.caption: تقویم کاربردی، پرسش‌های واقعی مشتری را به موضوع‌های مستقل و قابل بررسی تبدیل می‌کند.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original in-article editorial image about the different roles of an informative article and a service page.
Scene: intimate close elevated view of a premium midnight-teal research desk. One small open ivory booklet contains only a clean physical cutaway model of a precise mechanical repair assembly, a tiny measuring caliper and one carefully separated replacement piece, suggesting an in-depth answer to a practical customer decision. Beside it at some distance a broader closed service folio supports an orderly complete service toolkit in a shallow fitted tray. One fine mint ribbon connects the useful booklet to the service folio without merging them.
Composition: clear visual contrast between narrow detailed explanation and broader service scope, no split-screen, no collage, tactile physical editorial still life. Landscape 16:9, close camera, generous dark negative space, polished but credible materials.
Palette: midnight teal #001014/#031b22, restrained cyan mint #00dfd6/#76e8db, warm ivory paper, brushed steel. Soft controlled studio lighting and crisp focal detail.
Constraints: no words, letters, numerals, annotations, logos, watermarks, charts, testimonials or screen interfaces. All paper blank. Avoid laptops, giant icons, floating cubes, generic gears with no purpose. Illustrative objects, not client evidence.
assets.alt: دفتر راهنمای جزئیات یک قطعه مکانیکی در کنار مجموعه ابزار کامل خدمات و روبان ارتباطی
assets.caption: مقاله یک پرسش محدود را پاسخ می‌دهد و صفحه خدمت، محدوده و مسیر دریافت خدمت را روشن می‌کند.
assets.afterHeading: مقاله و صفحه خدمت نقش متفاوت دارند

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original in-article editorial image showing publishing followed by review and improvement.
Scene: a beautiful compact editorial workbench, viewed almost overhead, made from midnight-teal stone. Three distinct shallow brushed-metal paper trays are arranged around one continuous slender mint glass loop. A small stack of blank ivory drafts sits in the first tray; one carefully opened paper folio with a subtle embossed geometric shape sits in the second under a precise inspection loupe; a refined single finished folio sits in the third. A single loose revision card returns along the curved loop toward the drafts. The physical arrangement tells a maintainable publication-review-revision cycle, not mass production.
Style: exceptionally clean premium editorial 3D product photography, realistic paper fibres and brushed-metal texture, disciplined negative space and elegant proportions, landscape 16:9.
Palette: deep #001014/#031b22, restrained mint #00dfd6/#76e8db reflections, soft warm ivory. Broad diffused top light, gentle realistic shadows.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, printed lines, arrows, logos, watermarks, fake charts, computers, robots, newspapers, clocks, generic shields or giant cubes. All sheets blank. One coherent scene, not a montage.
assets.alt: سه سینی کاغذ و ذره‌بین روی میز سبز تیره در یک مسیر حلقه‌ای بازبینی محتوا
assets.caption: انتشار با بازبینی، دریافت بازخورد و اصلاح محتوای قبلی ادامه پیدا می‌کند.
